data.summary: The staging directory contains dbt source configurations and SQL models responsible for cleaning, standardizing, and preparing raw operational data tables (customers, products, orders, and order items) for downstream analytics. The files work together to define data sources and apply consistent transformations such as string trimming and lowercase normalization.

file_insights.name: _sources.yml
file_insights.summary: Configuration file defining the operational data store (ods) sources and tables for dbt models.
file_insights.source_summary: Defines version 2 sources for the 'ods' schema, listing source tables customers, products, orders, and order_items.
file_insights.detailed_description: Defines the source schema and tables for the operational data store (ods) within the staging layer. This acts as the configuration layer mapping raw source tables for downstream data transformations.
responsibilities: List raw source tables including customers, products, orders, and order_items

file_insights.name: stg_customers.sql
file_insights.summary: Staging model for cleaning and standardizing customer data from the ods source.
file_insights.source_summary: Executes a SQL select query against the ods.customers source table, applying string trimming and lowercase normalization to specific fields.
file_insights.detailed_description: Transforms the raw customer source table by cleaning string fields, trimming names and cities, normalizing membership tiers, and selecting relevant columns.
responsibilities: Clean and trim customer names and cities
Normalize membership tiers to lower case
Select customer identifier and update timestamps

file_insights.name: stg_order_items.sql
file_insights.summary: Staging model for pulling order item details from the ods source.
file_insights.source_summary: Executes a SQL select query against the ods.order_items source table to extract order item attributes.
file_insights.detailed_description: Extracts order item details from the raw ods source, preserving identifiers, quantities, unit prices, and update timestamps.
responsibilities: Expose quantities and unit prices for downstream usage
Preserve relationship between orders, products, and order items

file_insights.name: stg_orders.sql
file_insights.summary: Staging model for cleaning and formatting order data.
file_insights.source_summary: Executes a SQL select query against the ods.orders source table with status normalization and trimming.
file_insights.detailed_description: Transforms raw order records by normalizing order status to lowercase and preserving customer identifiers and order timestamps.
responsibilities: Track order placement and update times

file_insights.name: stg_products.sql
file_insights.summary: Staging model for standardizing product attributes from the ods source.
file_insights.source_summary: Executes a SQL select query against the ods.products source table with text cleaning transformations.
file_insights.detailed_description: Cleans product details from the ods source by trimming product names, normalizing category values to lowercase, and retaining pricing information.
responsibilities: Expose product price and update timestamps
